Recently got my hands on the Oversized Villan cards and some board game time since I am switching internet providers.

All 3 games I played got crushed against the villans. Though I find the pace for them much more attractive and there is more imminent threat than the regular versions of them.

Not sure if I was doing anything wrong. Linked the reports of my playthrough.

posts.name: Craig
posts.cooked: Sounds about right for MBB. He's kind of swingy, in my opinion, though. With the right card draws, you can almost sit back and play on auto-pilot. But with standard or bad draws, he's a beast. Pile the damage on, and do it quickly. Burn heroes out, if necessary.

posts.name: j1hopki1
posts.cooked:
It sounds like you didn't make any rule errors. That's sometimes a reason a new villain cleans your clock.

Rook City really doesn't help. That place is a ****hole.

I would like to note that AZ should not be doing much healing against either Baron Blade. He ramps up fast. This ain't no Dawn fight. AZ should tear through his 29 HP, dealing it right back to Blade. If you do that then Tempest and Legacy would only need to deal around 40 to win.

Cosmic Omnitron is just hard. It is one of the few villains that is harder with 5 heroes than with 3. I have a short guide to beating it here:

https://greaterthangames.com/forum/topic/seek-help-vs-cosmic-omnitron-2937

Someone mentioned I should put guides in their own thread. I think I might do that. Overall I love the promo villains.
